step1_figure.circuit_type: Latched Sense Amplifier / Clocked Comparator with SR Latch
step1_figure.description: The circuit is the low-power clocked sense amplifier of Fig. 16.32 combined with a cross-coupled NAND SR latch (Fig. 16.35) and input long-length driving inverters (xm11-xm14) used to evaluate clock feedthrough and kickback noise (Fig. 16.37).

kickback_noise.description: Peak voltage disturbance coupled onto the input nodes (Inp / Inm) due to clock feedthrough and capacitive coupling through the input transistors when the clock switches.

equation.explanation: When clock transitions high, the internal nodes experience large transient swings that couple back through the gate-to-channel and gate-to-drain capacitances of the input/isolation transistors onto the input lines.
equation.assumptions: Inputs driven by high-impedance / long-channel inverters as in test topology (Fig 16.28 / 16.37).

sky130_expected.calculation: In the textbook (page 456), kickback noise is simulated to be approximately 5 mV for a 1 V supply. In SKY130 at VDD = 1.8 V, capacitive coupling scales with the 1.8 V clock swing, giving V_kickback ≈ 5 mV * (1.8 / 1.0) ≈ 9 mV to 15 mV depending on device widths.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Three series transistors (MS1, M1, MB1) isolate the clock from the input node, keeping feedthrough well below 30 mV.

minimum_input_voltage.description: Minimum input common-mode voltage required to turn on input transistors MB1 and MB2 for proper latch sensing and ground reference.

equation.explanation: If the input voltages are below V_THN, MB1 and MB2 turn off, failing to provide the pull-down current paths needed to establish an imbalance and complete sensing.
equation.assumptions: Substrate of MB1/MB2 tied to ground (no body effect on MB1/MB2, V_SB = 0).

sky130_expected.calculation: For the standard nfet_01v8 in SKY130 with zero body bias: V_THN = 0.42 V. Thus, V_in,min must exceed 0.42 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: NMOS zero-bias threshold voltage in SKY130 nominal process is typically 0.42 V.

sensitivity.description: Minimum resolvable differential input voltage (V_In+ - V_In-) that reliably toggles the output latch state.

equation.explanation: The textbook notes that the sensitivity of this sense amplifier topology is better than 10 mV without requiring an explicit preamplifier.
equation.assumptions: Balanced layout with low threshold mismatch between differential pairs.

sky130_expected.calculation: With g_m = sqrt(2 * un * Cox * (W/L) * I_D) and triode resistance modulation Delta_R_DS = Delta_V_in / (un * Cox * (W/L) * (V_GS - V_THN)^2), a 10 mV differential produces sufficient current imbalance to trigger regenerative latching within 1-2 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker states sensitivity is better than 10 mV for standard sizing.

peak_switching_current.description: Peak current drawn from VDD during clock transitions when the latch evaluates and regenerates.

equation.explanation: Current flows only during switching times to charge/discharge internal and load capacitances through the cross-coupled inverters and output NAND SR latch.
equation.assumptions: No DC paths from VDD to ground when clock is static.

sky130_expected.calculation: In Fig 16.36 (1.0 V supply), peak current is ~180 uA. In SKY130 with VDD = 1.8 V, saturation current scales as (VDD - Vth)^2 / (1.0 - Vth)^2 ≈ (1.8 - 0.42)^2 / (1.0 - 0.42)^2 ≈ 5.6x, yielding expected peaks between 250 uA and 800 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Transient switching current is dominated by node capacitance charging at 1.8 V.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench measuring kickback noise on Inp/Inm during clock transition, peak switching current from VDD, and output transition resolving full logic levels across clock cycles.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Latched Sense Amplifier (Baker Fig 16.32 / 16.35 / 16.37)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=2u L_xm1=0.18u
.param W_xm2=2u L_xm2=0.18u
.param W_xm3=2u L_xm3=0.18u
.param W_xm4=1u L_xm4=0.18u
.param W_xm5=2u L_xm5=0.18u
.param W_xm6=2u L_xm6=0.18u
.param W_xm7=1u L_xm7=0.18u
.param W_xm8=2u L_xm8=0.18u
.param W_xm9=2u L_xm9=0.18u
.param W_xm10=2u L_xm10=0.18u
.param W_xm11=1u L_xm11=2u
.param W_xm12=1u L_xm12=2u
.param W_xm13=1u L_xm13=2u
.param W_xm14=1u L_xm14=2u

* DUT Netlist
xm1 N003 Inp 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 N004 Inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
X_U1 Outp Q Qi VDD 0 NAND_2
X_U2 Qi Outm Q VDD 0 NAND_2
xm11 Inp VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
xm12 Inp VDD 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
xm13 Inm 0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm13} l={L_xm13}
xm14 Inm 0 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm14} l={L_xm14}

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1u l=0.15u
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1u l=0.15u
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1u l=0.15u
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1u l=0.15u
.ends NAND_2

* Clock source: 10 ns period (100 MHz), 50% duty cycle
Vclk clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 4.9n 10n)

.control
tran 10p 25n

* Kickback noise: measure disturbance on Inp/Inm around the 20ns clock edge
meas tran v_inp_base find v(Inp) at=19.5n
meas tran v_inp_min min v(Inp) from=19.8n to=21.0n
meas tran v_inp_max max v(Inp) from=19.8n to=21.0n
let kickback_inp = v_inp_max - v_inp_min
print kickback_inp

meas tran v_inm_base find v(Inm) at=19.5n
meas tran v_inm_min min v(Inm) from=19.8n to=21.0n
meas tran v_inm_max max v(Inm) from=19.8n to=21.0n
let kickback_inm = v_inm_max - v_inm_min
print kickback_inm

* Peak switching current from VDD
meas tran idd_peak max -i(VDD) from=19.0n to=21.0n
print idd_peak

* Output logic levels
meas tran v_q_val find v(Q) at=24.5n
meas tran v_qi_val find v(Qi) at=24.5n
print v_q_val v_qi_val

quit
.endc
.end
